name: Udaan Academy
tagline: Coaching on GT Road for the exam in front of you.
description: Udaan Academy is a coaching centre on GT Road in Phagwara, Punjab, a short way from Lovely Professional University. Courses cover IELTS and PTE, JEE and NEET foundation for classes 11 and 12, Punjab board tuition for classes 9 to 12, and spoken English.
phoneNote: This phone number is a placeholder. It is not a working line.
emailNote: This address is a placeholder. The site does not send email.
hours: Monday to Saturday, 6:30 am to 8:00 pm. Sunday, 9:00 am to 1:00 pm for weekend batches and the doubt desk.

location.near: A short way from Lovely Professional University
lines: Landmark only: near Lovely Professional University
location.disclaimer: A fictional coaching centre on GT Road in Phagwara. No real PIN code, no STD code, and not a map pin on any real institution.

courses.name: IELTS & PTE
courses.summary: Module practice and weekly mock tests for students planning to study or settle abroad.
about: The batch works through listening, reading, writing, and speaking, with one full mock test each week. You get the paper back with notes on what to fix, not a promise of a band.
Most students on GT Road take this before a study visa or a work visa. Tell us which test you are sitting — IELTS Academic, IELTS General, or PTE — on the first day.
courses.eligibility: Class 12 students, graduates, and working people. You do not need a previous score.
includes: Writing feedback on two tasks a week

pitch.en: If you are heading to Canada or anywhere else abroad, IELTS and PTE is the course that fits.
pitch.hi: कनाडा या कहीं और बाहर जाना है तो IELTS और PTE का कोर्स सही रहेगा।
pitch.pa: ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਜਾਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਦੇਸ਼ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ IELTS ਅਤੇ PTE ਦਾ ਕੋਰਸ ਠੀਕ ਰਹੇਗਾ।

courses.eligibilityHi: क्लास 12 के छात्र, ग्रेजुएट और जॉब वाले लोग। पहले का स्कोर ज़रूरी नहीं।
courses.eligibilityPa: ਕਲਾਸ 12 ਦੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ, ਗ੍ਰੈਜੂਏਟ ਅਤੇ ਨੌਕਰੀ ਵਾਲੇ। ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ।

courses.name: JEE Foundation
courses.summary: Physics, chemistry, and maths for class 11 and 12 students sitting JEE Main.
about: The year follows the class 11 and 12 syllabus and adds JEE-style questions once a chapter is steady. Sunday of the weekend batch is a timed paper.
This is foundation coaching beside school, not a residential camp. Homework is short enough to finish on a school night.
courses.eligibility: Students in class 11 or 12, or a drop year, with physics, chemistry, and maths.
includes: Doubt session after the evening batch
One full paper on the weekend

pitch.en: Class 11 or 12 with an engineering aim sits in JEE Foundation — physics, chemistry, and maths.
pitch.hi: क्लास 11 या 12 में इंजीनियरिंग का टारगेट हो तो JEE फाउंडेशन सही रहेगा। फ़िज़िक्स, केमिस्ट्री और मैथ्स पढ़ाई जाती है।
pitch.pa: ਕਲਾਸ 11 ਜਾਂ 12 ਵਿੱਚ ਇੰਜੀਨੀਅਰਿੰਗ ਦਾ ਟੀਚਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ JEE ਫਾਊਂਡੇਸ਼ਨ ਠੀਕ ਰਹੇਗਾ। ਫਿਜ਼ਿਕਸ, ਕੈਮਿਸਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਥ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

courses.eligibilityHi: क्लास 11 या 12 के छात्र, या एक ड्रॉप ईयर, जिनके पास फ़िज़िक्स, केमिस्ट्री और मैथ्स हो।
courses.eligibilityPa: ਕਲਾਸ 11 ਜਾਂ 12 ਦੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ, ਜਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਡ੍ਰਾਪ ਈਅਰ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਫਿਜ਼ਿਕਸ, ਕੈਮਿਸਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਥ ਹੋਵੇ।

courses.name: NEET Foundation
courses.summary: Biology-heavy foundation for class 11 and 12 students aiming at NEET.
about: Biology gets the longest hour. Physics and chemistry stay in the same batch so you are not running between centres.
We do not publish ranks or selection counts here. A centre would add those only with the student’s permission.
courses.eligibility: Students in class 11 or 12 medical, or a drop year, with physics, chemistry, and biology.

pitch.en: Class 11 or 12 medical belongs in NEET Foundation. Biology leads, with physics and chemistry in the same batch.
pitch.hi: क्लास 11 या 12 मेडिकल है तो NEET फाउंडेशन सही रहेगा। बायोलॉजी ज़्यादा पढ़ाई जाती है, फ़िज़िक्स और केमिस्ट्री उसी बैच में रहती हैं।
pitch.pa: ਕਲਾਸ 11 ਜਾਂ 12 ਮੈਡੀਕਲ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ NEET ਫਾਊਂਡੇਸ਼ਨ ਠੀਕ ਰਹੇਗਾ। ਬਾਇਓਲੋਜੀ ਵੱਧ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਫਿਜ਼ਿਕਸ ਅਤੇ ਕੈਮਿਸਟਰੀ ਉਸੇ ਬੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।

courses.eligibilityHi: क्लास 11 या 12 मेडिकल के छात्र, या एक ड्रॉप ईयर, जिनके पास फ़िज़िक्स, केमिस्ट्री और बायोलॉजी हो।
courses.eligibilityPa: ਕਲਾਸ 11 ਜਾਂ 12 ਮੈਡੀਕਲ ਦੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ, ਜਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਡ੍ਰਾਪ ਈਅਰ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਫਿਜ਼ਿਕਸ, ਕੈਮਿਸਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਇਓਲੋਜੀ ਹੋਵੇ।

courses.name: Punjab Board Tuition
courses.summary: School tuition for Punjab School Education Board classes 9 to 12.
about: Classes follow the PSEB textbook. The aim is the school exam in March, with room for a student who is also sitting JEE or NEET to keep board answers clean.
Class 9 and 10 sit together for maths and science. Class 11 and 12 are split by stream once the group is large enough. Until then, the teacher sets separate homework.
courses.eligibility: Students enrolled in Punjab board classes 9, 10, 11, or 12.

pitch.en: Punjab board classes 9 to 12 are taught from the PSEB textbook. The school exam is the target.
pitch.hi: पंजाब बोर्ड की क्लास 9 से 12 की ट्यूशन PSEB की किताब से चलती है। टारगेट स्कूल का एग्ज़ाम है।
pitch.pa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ ਕਲਾਸ 9 ਤੋਂ 12 ਦੀ ਟਿਊਸ਼ਨ PSEB ਦੀ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਤੋਂ ਚੱਲਦੀ ਹੈ। ਟੀਚਾ ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਹੈ।

courses.eligibilityHi: पंजाब बोर्ड की क्लास 9, 10, 11 या 12 में पढ़ने वाले छात्र।
courses.eligibilityPa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ ਕਲਾਸ 9, 10, 11 ਜਾਂ 12 ਵਿੱਚ ਪੜ੍ਹਦੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ।

courses.name: Spoken English
courses.summary: A small batch for people who understand English and want to speak it.
about: Each class is mostly talking: a short prompt, pair work, then a correction that does not stop the story. Grammar is a note at the end, not the whole hour.
Shopkeepers, class 11 students, and parents sit in the same batch. You will be asked to speak on the first day.
courses.eligibility: Class 8 and above, and adults. No entrance test.
includes: A short voice note to re-record at home

pitch.en: Spoken English is the small batch for people who want the words to come out, not another grammar chapter.
pitch.hi: अंग्रेज़ी बोलनी है तो स्पोकन इंग्लिश का बैच सही रहेगा। क्लास में ज़्यादातर बात होती है, ग्रामर का लंबा चैप्टर नहीं।
pitch.pa: ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਬੋਲਣੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਪੋਕਨ ਇੰਗਲਿਸ਼ ਦਾ ਬੈਚ ਠੀਕ ਰਹੇਗਾ। ਕਲਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾਤਰ ਗੱਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਗ੍ਰਾਮਰ ਦਾ ਲੰਮਾ ਚੈਪਟਰ ਨਹੀਂ।

courses.eligibilityHi: क्लास 8 और उससे ऊपर, और बड़े लोग। कोई एंट्रेंस टेस्ट नहीं।
courses.eligibilityPa: ਕਲਾਸ 8 ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਪਰ, ਅਤੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਲੋਕ। ਕੋਈ ਦਾਖਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ।

facilities.title: AC classrooms
facilities.body: Two air-conditioned rooms on the first floor, about eighteen seats each, so a speaking round still fits.

facilities.title: Mock tests
facilities.body: Timed papers for IELTS, JEE, NEET, and the board. A mock is practice. It is not a predicted score.

facilities.title: Library corner
facilities.body: PSEB textbooks, NCERT, and a shelf of IELTS practice books you can sit with between batches.

facilities.title: Doubt sessions
facilities.body: A teacher stays back after the evening batch on weekdays, and the Sunday desk is open from 10 to 1.

why.title: The fee is on the page
why.body: Monthly fees sit between ₹1,500 and ₹5,800. IELTS and PTE is a package, not a monthly bill. Nothing is added at the desk that was not written here.

why.title: Batches stay small
why.body: Eighteen seats, so the teacher can hear you speak and can tell whose homework came back.

why.title: Easy from GT Road
why.body: The centre is on GT Road in Phagwara, a short way from Lovely Professional University. Students come from Phagwara town and the highway side.

why.title: Doubt time is on the timetable
why.body: It is not a favour you have to ask for. The evening teacher stays, and Sunday morning is a doubt desk.

faqs.question: Is Udaan Academy a real centre?
faqs.answer: Udaan Academy on this website is fictional. A local business can replace the name, courses, and photos. The phone number and address are placeholders.

faqs.question: Do you promise a band score or a rank?
faqs.answer: No. This site does not show scores, ranks, or selection counts. A real centre would add only results it can stand behind, with the student’s permission.

faqs.question: Can I sit in a class before I pay?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book a free trial class and pick a course, a batch, and a date. One trial per phone number per day.

faqs.question: Which board do you teach?
faqs.answer: Punjab School Education Board, classes 9 to 12. JEE and NEET batches follow the class 11 and 12 science syllabus beside that.

faqs.question: Do you take fees online?
faqs.answer: No. Fees are paid at the centre. The site stores a trial-class request and does not take payment.

faqs.question: Will someone call me back?
faqs.answer: The centre would call the number you leave. This website stores the request and shows you a reference number. It does not send email, and the phone on this page is not a working line.

results.title: Your results showcase
results.body: A working coaching site would place verified scores here, with permission from the students. This space stays empty on purpose. It does not invent band scores, ranks, or selection counts.

pages.heroBody: IELTS and PTE if you are leaving. JEE or NEET foundation if you are in class 11 or 12. Punjab board tuition if the school exam is the one that matters this year. Spoken English if you want the words to come out. Fees are on the page.
pages.illustrationNote: Illustrated on purpose, instead of a stock photograph.
pages.coursesIntro: Five courses that actually get asked for on GT Road. Open one for timings, who can join, and what a week looks like.
pages.feesIntro: Indicative ranges for Phagwara. Monthly classes sit between ₹1,500 and ₹5,800. IELTS and PTE is a package, not a monthly bill. A real centre confirms the figure at the desk before you pay. This page does not take payment.
